# BE-56 official public-office fixtures

Dated read-only qualification, 2026-11-07. Scope JSON manifests identify the exact
original gzip payloads, source URLs, SHA-256 hashes and capture times; decompressing
recovers the original bytes. Only referenced captures are retained. These files
support deterministic offline tests, not a production population claim.

The source matrix, fields, provider selection, attribution/usage references,
publication-age limits and public DIP authentication provenance are documented in
[BE56_SOURCES](../../../docs/BE56_SOURCES.md). All 21 scope mappings are exercised
through acquisition/normalization and ontology validation. Shared failure/history
regressions and disposable graph/API evidence are separate from fixture counts.
